project.name: DealFlow360
project.contextPurpose: Portable project context covering backend and frontend work completed so far.
project.securityNote: This file intentionally contains no passwords, tokens, database credentials, or Clerk secrets.

architecture.backendFlow: Route -> Middleware -> Controller -> Service -> Mongoose Model -> MongoDB
architecture.frontendFlow: React Route -> Protected Route -> Page -> API Client -> Express API
architecture.authenticationFlow: Clerk session -> Clerk middleware -> syncUser -> req.user -> role authorization -> controller
architecture.businessLogicRule: Pricing, discounts, risk, approval, team access, and aggregations belong in services, not routes or controllers.

implemented: Frontend Clerk token injection into Axios requests

userDocument.teamRelationship: Sales Manager and Sales Representatives share teamId. Manager services use the authenticated manager _id to resolve that team.

notImplemented: Replacement of the teammate Clerk implementation

salesManager.security: Every manager route uses Clerk authentication, syncUser, and requireRole([SALES_MANAGER]). Manager IDs are taken from req.user._id, never request data.

salesRepresentative: customer.service.js: customer CRUD, search, tier filtering, pagination, duplicate email checks, soft deletion, active transaction checks
product.service.js: active product lookup, category/search filtering, pagination, product validation
pricing.service.js: pure monetary calculations including gross, discount, tax, total, cost, profit, and margin
discount.service.js: tier/category discount limits, excess discount detection, risk interface
quotation.service.js: quotation workflow orchestration, product/customer validation, recalculation, risk, approval, submission, cancellation
order.service.js: approved quotation conversion, order listing/details/cancellation
salesManager: managerDashboard.service.js: manager KPIs, team performance, recent activity, risk overview
managerQuotation.service.js: team scope resolution, team quotation listing/details/stats
managerApproval.service.js: pending approvals, team ownership checks, approve/reject transitions, audit writes
managerReport.service.js: sales, team, and product performance reports
services.managerAccessRule: A manager must have a teamId. Services find SALES_REP users sharing that teamId and optional companyId, then filter quotation/order salesRep fields by those IDs.

controllers.controllerRule: Controllers translate request data to service calls and forward errors; they do not calculate pricing, risk, discounts, or approval rules.

errors.sensitiveDetails: Stack traces and database credentials are not returned to clients.

database.startupBehavior: Server starts only after the database connection succeeds.
database.seedConnectionBehavior: Seed connects once and closes the connection in finally.

seed.repeatability: Clears demo-owned customers, products, subscriptions, discount rules, quotations, orders, and users with clerkUserId beginning seed-. Non-seed users are preserved.
seed.relationships: Generated ObjectIds and shared generated teamId are used; no hardcoded database ObjectIds.

environment.jwtNote: JWT_SECRET is listed for compatibility with the project request, but the current authentication implementation is Clerk-based.

authentication.tokenFlow: AuthTokenProvider obtains getToken and configures the Axios request interceptor.
authentication.userFlow: useCurrentUser calls /api/me and ProtectedInternalRoute redirects based on the synchronized role.

apiIntegration.requestBehavior: Clerk bearer token is attached automatically when available.

salesRepFeatures: Quotation builder with customer/product selection, quantity, discount, and backend recalculation
Quotation detail with totals, margin, risk, approval, submit/cancel, recommendations
